correctness.rationale: A complete constructive proof fixes the Fibonacci indexing and canonical-palindrome constraints, proves the cardinalities by admissible half-words, the every-third-length parity resonance via symmetric Fibonacci weights, the 12-phase bounded discrepancy via two explicitly squared-to-identity transfer products, and the eventual gcd via four explicit admissible witnesses whose differences combine to -10 and -16. Exact finite enumeration covers the boundary lengths; standalone checker separately reconstructs 121368 canonical expansions and cross-checks lengths through 25. The infinite conclusion depends on the algebraic proof, not the experiments.

value.rationale: This naturally defined, independently catalogued integer family has exponentially many members at growing lengths, yet parity exhibits a sharp three-divisibility resonance and an exact uniformly bounded 12-phase discrepancy otherwise; the common divisor of all represented values is completely classified. These are structural statements identifying a natural obstruction and quantifying balance; the transfer involutions and universal gcd witnesses explain why, unlike a routine lookup or a narrow numeric slice.
